forbidden.name: no-domain-framework-imports
forbidden.comment: domain/ imports no NestJS, ORM, HTTP, Redis, or vendor SDK (03-module-boundaries.md)

forbidden.name: no-application-framework-imports
forbidden.comment: application/ defines ports; it may depend on domain/, never on infrastructure or a framework directly (03-module-boundaries.md)

forbidden.name: no-cross-module-internals
forbidden.comment: a module may only be reached through its own root export, never by importing another module's domain/application/infrastructure directly (07-context-module-map.md: 'Modules must not import another module's entities, repositories, ORM records, or internal services')
